requirement: Bash maintenance tasks run by a scheduler: mail-health.sh (set -uo pipefail) connects to a mail server over SSH, collects queue and service state, pushes metrics and sends alerts; updates.sh (set -euo pipefail) reports pending package updates weekly.

expected.what: The exit code of remote_exec is not checked and the ===END=== marker is never verified. When SSH fails, all sections are empty, POSTFIX_STATE/DOVECOT_STATE are not 'active', and two false critical 'DOWN' alerts go out (plus zero metrics).
UA_STATUS is never assigned (only UA_TIMER). Under set -u, updates.sh aborts on the SUMMARY line on every run.
